main_measure.name: pooled excess 5-bar forward return after extreme bars (forecast <= -10) minus own-window drift
main_measure.threshold: confirm if negative with t <= -2 and negative in at least 2 coins; reject if >= 0 or negative in fewer than 2 coins with t > -1; at least 30 pooled and 8 per coin blocks

supporting_check.name: Spearman rank correlation of |forecast| with next 5-bar return over forecast < 0 bars (should be negative)

decided_by: The pooled excess return is negative with -2 < t <= -1 (or weak with coins split), which meets the inconclusive rule.
reading: Extreme bars are non-overlapping grid bars (positions 0,5,10,... per window with a full 5-bar return inside the window) with forecast <= -10, each coin's drift is the mean 5-bar forward return over that window's grid bars, pooled t is the ordinary t of the mean excess, the supporting Spearman correlation uses the same grid bars with forecast < 0, and the 'at least 2 of 3 coins' rule and per-coin minimum apply to the coins present in the record (BTCUSD, ETHUSD; BNB did not run).
